data.train: official Daily Top Episodes 2026-09-06, 662 episodes, module_version 1.32.7
data.frozen_validation: official Daily Top Episodes 2026-09-14, 654 episodes, module_version 1.32.7

core_model: conditional empirical long-horizon scenario model; no trajectory clustering
price_model: deterministic monotone inventory->price lookup learned from 9/06; no conflicts observed in the 337 inventory values seen across 9/06+9/14

d9_states.3: D9 Yarn first appears as shop3

d12_branches.0: B0 no Yarn at D12; sheep_age9p <= 3
d12_branches.1: B1 no Yarn at D12; sheep_age9p >= 4

update_policy.D8: broad early scenario distribution; do not force a final long-horizon branch
update_policy.D9_D11: use current known shop chain + sheep_age9p structural state. Re-anchor empirical delta-inventory scenarios to current inventory. D9 is the earliest strong long-horizon value split.
update_policy.D12: full shop chain is known; branch becomes directly observed by D12 rules; switch to D12 branch scenario library.
update_policy.after_D12: condition branch scenarios on accumulated inventory residual. For current residual r at elapsed e, future residual is rho_b,e(h)*r + eta_j,b,e(h), eta_j=R_j(h)-rho_b,e(h)*R_j(e).
update_policy.residual_OOD: flag when current residual lies outside branch/day 1%-99% train support. Keep residual-corrected center but lower confidence/use downside scenarios.

counterfactual_value_rule: Historical scenarios already include normal future supply from both players. Apply only candidate-vs-baseline incremental market impact: I_candidate = I_reference + impact(candidate) - impact(baseline).
value_formula: V(a|s)=sum_s w_s * sum_h discount(h) * [official_transaction_revenue(q_a(h), I_s(h)+impact_delta_a(h)) - incremental_cost_a(h)].
